offering_description.value: Innoviva earns royalties on inhaled medicines for asthma and COPD that its pharmaceutical partner sells. It develops and commercializes specialty medicines for hospitals and other healthcare providers, focusing on serious infections and critical care.

primary_products.value: inhaled asthma and COPD medicines sold by a royalty partner; hospital antibiotics; vasopressors for septic and other distributive shock; oral antibiotics for gonorrhea

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical licensees, drug wholesalers, hospitals and health systems

end_markets.value: respiratory care; infectious disease treatment; hospital critical care; sexual health

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Royalties tied to a pharmaceutical partner’s sales of inhaled respiratory medicines; product sales: Specialty antibiotics and critical care medicines sold through pharmaceutical distribution channels

value_chain_position.value: other: Holds rights to royalties on respiratory medicines commercialized by a pharmaceutical partner; brand owner: Develops or licenses specialty drugs and uses contract manufacturers to supply pharmaceutical wholesalers and healthcare providers

geography_served.value: global: U.S. specialty drug commercialization and worldwide respiratory medicine sales through a pharmaceutical partner

specialization.value: related lines: Respiratory drug royalties, specialty antibiotics and critical care medicines

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Pharmaceutical licensee that markets and distributes inhaled respiratory medicines worldwide; distributors / dealers: Pharmaceutical wholesalers supplying hospital and specialty medicines; direct sales: Specialty pharmaceutical sales teams serving hospitals and health systems
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; distributors / dealers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Prescription drug approvals, manufacturing standards and postmarketing safety oversight by the FDA and other national regulators

notes: The current rollout of its gonorrhea antibiotic and the full country coverage of its specialty medicines are uncertain.
